name: edgedancer
description: Surgebinders who wield Abrasion and Progression. Edgedancers are graceful, quiet warriors who remember those the world forgets. They move like whispers and heal like hope.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Edgedancer swears to care for those overlooked, choosing to notice the ignored and remember the forgotten.
quotes: I will listen to those who have been ignored.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: They vow to act on behalf of the voiceless, not just to remember — but to speak, move, and heal in their name.
quotes: I will remember those who cannot speak for themselves.
I will be swift and gentle, like the wind through grass.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: The Edgedancer becomes a living extension of mercy and motion — ever-present, ever-compassionate.
quotes: I will not let the forgotten be lost again.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: They embody grace in defiance and healing in sorrow. Where others look away, the Edgedancer walks toward pain and erasure.
quotes: Even if the world forgets them, I will not.
